related.title: MIT Kerberos：票證、主體與時鐘邊界
related.titleEn: MIT Kerberos: tickets, principals and clock boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩種長度符合規格範圍，錯誤verifier與重複授權碼皆拒絕；範例不儲存真實存取權杖。 交付協定序列圖、verifier測試向量指紋及權杖消耗狀態表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both lengths meet protocol bounds, mismatched verifiers and repeated codes are rejected, and no real access tokens are stored. Deliver a protocol sequence, fingerprints of verifier test vectors and token-consumption states.
related.difference: 畫出測試realm的使用者、TGT、服務票證與服務主體；將票證有效期、可更新期限、時鐘偏差分開，不展示keytab內容。
related.differenceEn: Map a test realm user, TGT, service ticket and service principal; separate validity, renewable lifetime and clock skew without exposing keytab contents.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: PKCE將授權碼兌換綁到verifier；若verifier由均勻隨機位元組產生，原始熵上限為8n位元，但不等於整個系統安全強度。 教學verifier來源為32個獨立均勻隨機位元組，再做無填補base64url編碼；不使用可預測時間戳。 原始熵32×8=256位元；48位元組版本為384位元。編碼長度分別43與64字元，編碼不創造額外熵。
剩餘有效期=endtime−now，不能用renew-till代替endtime；票證可更新不代表過期票證仍能直接使用。 合成服務票證endtime=7200秒、now=3600秒、renew-till=14400秒。 可用餘裕7200−3600=3600秒；將endtime縮為5400秒後餘裕1800秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: PKCE binds code redemption to a verifier; n uniformly random bytes provide at most 8n bits of source entropy, not the strength of the entire system. The teaching verifier starts with 32 independent uniform random bytes and uses unpadded base64url, not predictable timestamps. Source entropy is 32×8=256 bits; 48 bytes provide 384 bits. Encoded lengths are 43 and 64 characters; encoding adds no entropy.

Remaining validity is endtime−now, not renew-till−now; renewable tickets are not automatically usable after expiry. A synthetic service ticket has endtime=7200 seconds, now=3600 and renew-till=14400. Margin is 7200−3600=3600 seconds; shortening endtime to 5400 leaves 1800 seconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: WireGuard：密鑰路由、AllowedIPs 與封包預算
related.titleEn: WireGuard: cryptokey routing, AllowedIPs and packet budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩種長度符合規格範圍，錯誤verifier與重複授權碼皆拒絕；範例不儲存真實存取權杖。 交付協定序列圖、verifier測試向量指紋及權杖消耗狀態表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both lengths meet protocol bounds, mismatched verifiers and repeated codes are rejected, and no real access tokens are stored. Deliver a protocol sequence, fingerprints of verifier test vectors and token-consumption states.
related.difference: 用兩個離線peer設定表區分外層endpoint、隧道內來源與AllowedIPs；畫出送出路由選擇及收到後的來源範圍驗證。
related.differenceEn: Use two offline peer tables to distinguish outer endpoints, inner source addresses and AllowedIPs; diagram outbound peer selection and inbound source-range validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: PKCE將授權碼兌換綁到verifier；若verifier由均勻隨機位元組產生，原始熵上限為8n位元，但不等於整個系統安全強度。 教學verifier來源為32個獨立均勻隨機位元組，再做無填補base64url編碼；不使用可預測時間戳。 原始熵32×8=256位元；48位元組版本為384位元。編碼長度分別43與64字元，編碼不創造額外熵。
封包剩餘預算=路徑MTU−外層IP−UDP−WireGuard資料封裝；此預算尚未扣內層協定與可能填補。 路徑MTU1500位元組；無選項IPv4表頭20、UDP8、資料封裝32位元組。 1500−20−8−32=1440位元組；外層改無擴充IPv6表頭40時剩1420位元組。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: PKCE binds code redemption to a verifier; n uniformly random bytes provide at most 8n bits of source entropy, not the strength of the entire system. The teaching verifier starts with 32 independent uniform random bytes and uses unpadded base64url, not predictable timestamps. Source entropy is 32×8=256 bits; 48 bytes provide 384 bits. Encoded lengths are 43 and 64 characters; encoding adds no entropy.

Remaining packet budget equals path MTU minus outer IP, UDP and WireGuard data overhead; it is before inner protocols and possible padding. Path MTU is 1500 bytes; option-free IPv4 header is 20, UDP 8 and data encapsulation 32 bytes. 1500−20−8−32=1440 bytes; using a 40-byte IPv6 header without extensions leaves 1420 bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
